finding.text: Requirement 2 ("grow live", no jump when the final text replaces the guess) has no proof: the walkthrough and screens show only finished messages, and no test or shot shows a pill widening while words arrive.

V2 at 1920 draws the reply "Hello! What would you like to work on?" indented about 200px right of every other reply (icon at x=523 vs 321) — layout (alignment), screens/v2-1920.png, band 3. V3 has no such indent.

shots/ is empty and its layout.json is missing (session.jsonl logged widths 400/1200/1920/3440, `bands: []`), so nothing is measured; the review judged the builder's screens/ instead. The walkthrough also says the shots came from 127.0.0.1:62509, not monorepo.lew42.com as asked (req 5).
`ux/Dictate/readme.md` is stale: `Widget.css` changed and now sets `--bubble-max` for the Dictate bubbles, but the readme never mentions `ext/Chat/bubbles.css` or the shared token.

The assistant's text wraps well short of the 80% cap: at 1920 V2/V3 replies wrap at about 400-500px while the owner pill reaches 500px+ (screens/v2-1920.png, V3 "Compacted..." wraps at ~800px of 940). The two sides read as different max widths.
V2 shows a faded, right-aligned preview ("I would like the chat to look more...") directly above the long pill, a second copy of the same words (screens/v2-360.png, v2-1920.png).

No chat-layout/readme.md, and `past-work.md` and `screens/` are not linked from the walkthrough or the session record. A fresh agent can continue from `requirements.md` + `walkthrough.md` + the diff, but not from an index.

`ext/Chat/doc/scroll.md` line 30 is stale: it still says "Every bubble is `--chat-bubble` wide (85% of the column, at most 34rem)". This diff removed that token and that rule. It should say: your bubble hugs its text up to `--bubble-max`, the reply is plain text, see `bubbles.css`.

Do 5 (shots through `monorepo.lew42.com` with the phone UA) is still not met. The six `screens/` come from the worktree's own dev server, `127.0.0.1:62509`. The walkthrough gives a sound reason (the branch is not on that host until it merges, and the host answers 401 to a headless browser). Reshoot the six after the merge.

`shots/` is empty again and there is no `layout.json`, so nothing was measured. `session.jsonl` says `review.mjs` OutPath refuses an output folder inside a worktree. That is a `Server/review.mjs` gap, not this task's, and every worktree review will hit it. This review judged the builder's `screens/` instead.

The growth proof stops at the draft. `bubble-grow.mjs` checks guess → settled inside `.chat-v3-draft`, but not the swap from the draft to the real Prompt card when the sentence lands. The draft pill also has a 1px dashed border that the real pill doesn't, so the swap can still shift the width by about 2px.
The V1 half of `bubble-grow.mjs` sets `textContent` on an existing `.chatbox-you`. It doesn't go through `chat().live()`, the path a mic really uses, so it proves the CSS but not V1's live path.

In `ext/Chat/readme.md` the picture's alt text says "the three views at 360 px", but the picture shows V3 only. Also, the two new "Files that matter" bullets sit before a blank line, which splits that list in two.

The V3 reply text has looser lines (`.chat-v3-text` line-height 1.45) than V2's sentence replies, and it leaves a bigger gap above ▶ ↺10. Compare screens/v3-360.png band 3 with screens/v2-360.png band 3: the same reply runs about 50px against 40px a line.

At 1920 the chat column is only about 630px wide (x 310–940). About 630px of empty page sits to its right (screens/v3-1920.png, all bands). The 80% cap is 80% of that narrow column, so the long pill is 499px. This is the page's own measure and was there before this diff, but it is why the owner sees "80%" as about a quarter of the screen.
